heading: INT. DATA CENTER - COLD AISLE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. DATA CENTER - COLD AISLE - NIGHT
Rows of black server racks stretching into cold blue light.
Fans roar.
Cables hang like vines.
NADIA VOSKUIJLEN, thirties, a network engineer in a parka over her work shirt, crouches at an open rack, a laptop balanced on her knee.
ELIJAH CROSS, forties, her manager, stands behind her in a thin suit that is too cold for the room.
TEODORA MIHAI, twenties, a junior tech, stands at the aisle's end holding a flashlight and a clipboard.
HARLAN, fifties, a security guard, appears at the far door, backlit, one hand on his belt.
Someone has been copying the customer database to an outside address. Every night at 2:13.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Nadia, we should discuss this upstairs.
units.name: ELIJAH

units.text: It's ten past two. It's about to happen again.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: The traffic spike is already starting.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: Delete the log. We'll find who it is in the morning.
units.name: ELIJAH

units.text: Why would I delete the log?
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Because I'm asking.
units.name: ELIJAH

units.text: Harlan steps into the aisle.
His boots echo on the steel floor.
Is there a problem?
units.name: HARLAN

units.text: Mr. Cross is asking me to delete evidence.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Mr. Cross?
units.name: HARLAN

units.text: Harlan, this is an internal matter.
units.name: ELIJAH

units.text: I would need that in writing.
units.name: HARLAN

units.text: Elijah reaches into his jacket.
Everyone freezes.
He pulls out a phone and holds it up, shaking.
I'm making a call.
units.name: ELIJAH

units.text: It's two-thirteen.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: The server fans spin down.
The lights flicker.
Then a long beep.
Transfer complete.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Then it's done.
units.name: ELIJAH

units.text: It's done, Mr. Cross. And now we know where it went.
units.name: HARLAN

units.text: Nadia turns the laptop around.
The destination is Elijah's own home address.
I can explain.
units.name: ELIJAH

units.text: You'll have all night.
units.name: HARLAN
